name: issue-triage
description: Triage an incoming issue or ticket into area, type, severity, and whether it needs a repro or looks like a duplicate. State: the issue title + body (and comments, if useful) as plain text or {"title":..,"body":..}.

area.instructions: Which part of the system does this issue concern?

criteria.data: database schema, migrations, data quality, reporting
criteria.other: none of the above, or spans multiple areas

type.instructions: What kind of issue is this?

criteria.bug: something that used to work, or should work, is broken
criteria.feature: a request for new functionality that doesn't exist yet
criteria.question: someone is asking how something works or should work
criteria.chore: maintenance, refactor, dependency bump, or cleanup with no user-facing behavior change

severity.instructions: How severe is this issue's impact if it stays unresolved?
criteria: cosmetic or trivial: no functional impact
minor: a workaround exists, or it affects few users
major: no workaround, affects many users or a core workflow
critical: data loss, security exposure, or a full outage

needs_repro.instructions: Is this issue missing clear steps to reproduce, so someone would have to ask the reporter for more information before it can be worked on?

criteria.true: reproduction steps are missing or too vague to act on
criteria.false: reproduction steps are clear, or none are needed (e.g. a feature request)

duplicate_likely.instructions: Does this report read like a common, well-worn class of complaint or request (the kind that's often already been filed), rather than something novel or specific to this codebase?

criteria.true: reads like a generic, likely-already-filed complaint or request
criteria.false: reads like a specific or unusual report
